comparison.objective: Carry a 500 mm carrier bimanually through two offset guarded slots and set it down level.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-ended grasping, whole-body collision avoidance, and level transport through constrained apertures; no tooling or fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Carrier passes both offset slots and is deposited level; exact clearance and level tolerances are not included.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual coordination is generic; this tests coordinated large-object navigation rather than localized impact manipulation.
